reading_evidence: Read all five source/target stanzas: sleeping in Mother’s lap without sleep, her silence and absent lullaby, laughing flowers and vanished butterflies, blood and culpability, children as her regrets/sorrows, Gaza/Ukraine/Murshidabad cries explaining silence, and the final shameless sleep with open eyes while silence may last forever. Preserved the collective indictment and paradox rather than treating sleep as a factual inconsistency.
reason: In this indictment, बेधड़क describes untroubled indifference. Replace fearlessly with without a care so the continued sleep is not mistaken for courage.
tradeoff: The target loses the positive implication of fearlessness and retains the collective failure to respond; no identity for Mother or historical fact is supplied.

Retain the contrast and deliberately near-identical recurrence; no marriage or biographical circumstance is inferred.
reason: Give the repeated request normal English verb/object order; To me, just give was an unnecessary inversion. Both complete refrains examined individually and changed consistently.
tradeoff: Retain bound/bonds and fragrance/scent repetition because those are in the source. No simplification of the repeated freedom ending or line-count change.

before.label: English
before.title: O Unattached One, Listen
stanzas: Listen as you go, O unattached traveller,
why did you bewilder my heart?
My eyes now search for you;
why are you glad, having forgotten me?
The ache within never reached you;
At every sound these feet ran;
my eyes turned to stone, I gaze unblinking.
I did not meet you, yet longing lies concealed;
did you not hear my sigh?
I cannot speak of it, yet every moment,
traveller, keep sounding the depths of my heart.
put only my heart in the address.
O dyer, now fill it with colour;
did that heart-filled letter reach you?
Fill it with the blood-red of gulmohar,
make my body like spring-yellow amaltas.
Let me sway and blush like the green earth;

reading_evidence: Read the two cloud stanzas and closing couplet: repeated Time is a dense cloud, many rains and earth’s sure-footed reassurance/gusto, a gust dissolving the cloud and unlived breaths, wisps conveying sky’s illusion/gloom, then countless versus cipher holding many lives/deaths. Compared negation, capability, sound clusters and the earth/sky opposition in the full current target.
reason: Render gust as a sudden movement of wind; the existing ଝାଙ୍କ wording does not naturally name that action. Preserve mere touch and immediate vanishing.
open_questions: Unlived breaths remains intentionally strange; the exact reach of unlived/ଅଜିଆଁ awaits fluent review, not normalized to unbreathed or dead.
tradeoff: ଦଲକା keeps the wind movement concrete without adding a storm. The source’s cipher is read as zero in the countless contrast, not decoded as a secret message.
